title: GEO-82 Fireworks Experience | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: GEO-82 Fireworks Experience Located in World Celebration at EPCOT End your day in a dazzling way—with light bites, sparkling sips and seated fireworks views at the adult-exclusive GEO-82 lounge. Dining Events Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Check Available Days Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. Advance reservations are required.A Flavorful FinaleTreat your senses to a shimmering celebration in EPCOT with the GEO-82 Fireworks Experience—exclusive to Guests ages 21 and up. Sit back and savor an exquisite pairing of flavorful fare and fantastic fireworks views.Each Seat Is SuperbYou'll be perfectly positioned to enjoy dazzling fireworks views of Luminous The Symphony of Us, the nighttime spectacular.A Mouthwatering MenuThis elevated experience includes:Champagne that’s specially selected by sommeliers at Walt Disney World Resort (or event-exclusive cocktails, if you prefer)A tasting tower of savory light bites, available before Luminous The Symphony of Us beginsA selection of sweets during Luminous The Symphony of UsAbout Luminous The Symphony of UsWatch as the skies above EPCOT come alive with color during Luminous The Symphony of Us. It’s a sparkling pageant of fireworks, fountains, music and light—delightfully designed to bring us all together.About GEO-82Sip, savor and unwind in style at GEO-82, a sophisticated lounge with sweeping views of World Celebration Gardens and World Showcase Lagoon in EPCOT. GEO-82 is nestled alongside the iconic geodesic sphere that’s home to Spaceship Earth.Know Before You GoPriceThis experience is $179 per person, plus tax and gratuity.Theme park admission is required, but it is not included in the price of this event. Theme park reservations may be required based on admission type.ReservationsAdvance reservations are required; space is extremely limited. Learn when advance reservations can be made.Age RequirementThe GEO-82 Fireworks Experience is exclusive to Guests ages 21 and up with valid photo identification.Checking InPlease arrive at GEO-82 at your designated check-in time—60 minutes prior to Luminous The Symphony of Us.FireworksFireworks are not guaranteed as part of this experience; on rare occasions, evening fireworks may be rescheduled or cancelled. Please refer to the entertainment schedule to confirm showtimes 2 weeks prior to your reservation, and check again the day of your reservation.Subject to ChangeAll entertainment and experiences are subject to change without notice.ModificationsThis experience does not allow modifications once the reservation is confirmed. Learn MoreCancellationsThere is a 24-hour cancellation policy. Full price will be charged/forfeited if the Guest cancels within one day or fails to show up for the reservation.Related ActivitiesGEO-82EPCOTLa Crêperie de ParisEPCOTMake a Reservation
